Je m’appelle Clément Bertrand et je suis: My name is Clément Bertrand and I am a second-year student in the BUT Multimedia and Internet Professions (MMI) programme at IUT Nord Franche-Comté.
Passionné par le cinéma, la musique, je: Passionate about cinema and music, I see both as ways to convey emotions, to reveal the beauty and complexity of our world, and to bring to life worlds that only exist in our imagination.
Entre audiovisuel, 3D et design, j’explo: Between film, 3D and design, I explore different forms of creation with one ambition: to push the limits of my creativity, break the rules and offer experiences out of the ordinary.
Mes influences vont de David Lynch à Joh: My influences range from David Lynch to John Williams, by way of PNL and Kanye West. Very different worlds that inspire me through their staging, their compositions and the way they make images and sound speak to each other.
Ils m’encouragent à expérimenter et à dé: They push me to experiment and to develop a personal identity.
Je me définirais comme quelqu’un de spir: I would describe myself as spiritual, creative and ambitious.

Une question, quelques secondes, une rép: A question, a few seconds, an answer. Behind this simplicity, artificial intelligence relies on infrastructure and resources we never see. Made as a team, Derrière le prompt explores the environmental footprint of AI requests through three indicators: energy, CO₂ emissions and water. The goal: make these issues more tangible without reducing a complex subject to a single number.
Comment rendre compréhensibles des donné: How do you make sense of data we never see on screen? The visualisations let you compare models and explore the gaps between indicators. The work lies in ranking the information, choosing suitable representations and adding explanations to the numbers, for an accessible reading that does not hide their complexity.
Le site transforme cette analyse en un p: The site turns this analysis into an interactive journey. The results come with explanations and a page dedicated to the method, so everyone can go beyond the charts. The point is not to name a “clean” AI, but to give landmarks for understanding what our digital habits involve.
Derrière le prompt est un projet réalisé: Derrière le prompt is a project made in collaboration with Noah Litzler, as part of our BUT MMI.
Ensemble, nous avons cherché à rendre pl: Together, we tried to make the environmental impact of artificial intelligence easier to understand by giving a visual form to data that can be hard to grasp.
Ce travail en binôme nous a permis de co: Working as a pair let us challenge each other’s ideas and refine how to present these estimates, without hiding their limits or the complexity of the subject.
Le projet s’appuie sur un protocole de c: The project relies on a protocol comparing several artificial intelligence models. A Python script using EcoLogits gathers impact estimates, which are then organised and analysed in notebooks.
Ces données ne sont pas des mesures dire: These figures are not direct measurements: they rest on assumptions and carry uncertainties that must be made visible.

ÉBÈNE est un projet de site de lunettes: ÉBÈNE is a website project for wooden glasses with a built-in customisation journey. Users can choose their frame, explore different wood and lens shades, then see them combined. The project brings together brand design, product modelling and an interface for putting your pair together.
La création des lunettes commence dans B: The glasses start in Blender, with work on the silhouette and proportions. The lens shape, the frame thickness and the temple joints went through several adjustments. The aim was a model that holds together from every angle, while keeping simple lines that let the material speak.
Sur Figma, j’ai conçu les pages qui prés: In Figma, I designed the pages presenting the brand, the models and the customisation options. The mock-up had to combine a luxurious look with the handcrafted character of wooden glasses. I worked on spacing, typography and colours to express this, while giving room to the products and clearly ranking information and actions.
Le configurateur pose une question d’UX: The configurator raises a UX question: how do you offer several options without complicating the choice? I designed the journey to separate the frame, wood and lens choices while keeping a preview of the result. The goal is to let users compare, go back on a decision and always understand what they are customising.
Les illustrations apportent une autre ma: The illustrations offer another way to present the brand, alongside the 3D renders. They evoke its world and support the content of the mock-up. Integrating them means balancing images, text and breathing space: enriching the pages without drawing attention away from the glasses.

Deux présences. Deux chemins. Une même F: Two presences. Two paths. One Force. REFLECTIONS mirrors Yoda and Darth Vader to explore the fragile border between light and darkness, and to recall that balance is born precisely from the tension between the two.
REFLECTIONS explore la dualité qui trave: REFLECTIONS explores the duality running through the Star Wars universe through two opposing figures: Yoda and Darth Vader. Two characters bound to the same Force, yet taking radically different paths. Rather than simply opposing good and evil, the series tries to depict the constant tension between light and darkness, mastery and domination, balance and fall.
Chaque affiche a été entièrement composé: Each poster was entirely composed in Blender. The forest was built from the terrain, vegetation, trees, rocks and mist before the characters were placed in it.
Le travail des poses, des sabres, des ma: Work on the poses, lightsabers, materials, lighting and framing then turns this shared scene into two different images, while keeping a composition that links the posters together.
Les deux affiches prennent place dans un: Both posters take place in the same forest, as if a single environment could tip to either side of the Force. With Yoda, the setting turns cold, silent and almost spiritual.
Avec Vador, ce même espace se transforme: With Vader, the same space transforms: red floods the mist, the shadows close in and the atmosphere grows more threatening. The setting stays the same, but the character’s presence changes the way it is perceived entirely
La lumière comme expression de la Force: Light as the expression of the Force
La lumière devient le principal langage: Light becomes the main visual language of REFLECTIONS. Blue accompanies Yoda and creates a calmer, more contemplative atmosphere, while Vader’s red gradually contaminates his surroundings.
Les sabres ne sont alors plus de simples: The lightsabers are no longer mere props: they become light sources that reshape the characters, the forest and the mist around them. Colour thus suggests the presence of the Force without ever showing it directly.

Sparky est une intelligence artificielle: Sparky is a local artificial intelligence designed as a true personal assistant. Embodied by a robot, it has a presence, a face and a personality, turning an abstract technology into a recognisable companion.
Sparky fonctionne directement sur la mac: Sparky runs directly on the user’s machine thanks to a local artificial intelligence. The aim is a personal assistant that can hold a conversation, remember the context of its exchanges and support the user, while keeping their data on their own device.
Derrière Sparky se trouve toute une part: Behind Sparky lies a whole development side that connects the interface to the artificial intelligence and handles conversations, memory and the assistant’s various features. The project combines development, AI and 3D creation in a single experience.
Sparky est pensé comme un personnage cap: Sparky is designed as a character able to grow far beyond his interface. A lunar surface, a futuristic library, repairing a rocket… every new environment is a chance to imagine new interactions and gradually expand his world.
Sparky n’est pas pensé comme une IA figé: Sparky is not meant to be a static AI. His character comes to life through various animations and interactions: repairing a rocket, tidying books, thinking or simply waiting. Every movement helps build his personality and makes talking with the AI feel more alive.
La Salle SULL : entrer dans le cinéma: The SULL Theatre: stepping into cinema
SULL est un projet de plateforme de VOD: SULL is a video-on-demand platform project for film lovers. The idea: not to stop at choosing a film, but to make you want to discover what surrounds it. Directors, countries and film movements become so many ways in to explore works and broaden your references.
Élément phare du projet, la Salle SULL p: The project’s centrepiece, the SULL Theatre offers a 3D screening room right in the browser. The film plays on a screen set within a scene, rather than in a player isolated on a page.
Cette salle prolonge l’univers de la pla: This theatre extends the platform’s world and explores another way of staging viewing, working on space, point of view and lighting mood.
SULL a été réalisé en collaboration avec: SULL was made in collaboration with Noah Litzler. The project brings together interface design, web development and visual content creation around a single platform.
Les échanges et les ajustements au fil d: Our discussions and adjustments along the way helped the ideas evolve and tie the different parts of the site together.
Le développement associe Astro pour les: Development pairs Astro for the pages and interface with PocketBase for data and authentication. User accounts, favourites, profiles, discussions and video publishing require linking every action
à des données et à des droits d’accès. C: to data and access rights. This part of the project turns the intentions of the mock-up into working journeys, all the way to deploying the site.
La maquette organise les affiches, les i: The mock-up organises posters, information and editorial content to make this exploration easier.
Le travail graphique cherche un équilibr: The visual design looks for a balance between the atmosphere of cinema and the readability of a browsing platform.
L’identité se prolonge dans les visuels: The identity extends into the 3D visuals, notably the popcorn bucket and the film reel, designed to give SULL recognisable elements.
Un assistant IA accompagne la recherche: An AI assistant helps search for films and directors, while soundtracks offer a way in through music.
La dimension communautaire permet de pou: The community side keeps the conversation going through discussions and profiles.
Un espace créateur complète cet ensemble: A creator space completes the whole, letting users publish their own videos: SULL is not only for those who watch, but also for those who create.
